iconography.realia_identification: Feline head in full face (Cretan wildcat / Felis lybica)
iconography.iconographic_notes: Identified in Evans (1909), Duhoux (1977), and Godart (1995) as Cat's Head.

phonetics.epistemic_warning: Phonetic value ['/za/'] is an unverified projection from Linear A/B. Cannot be considered established decipherment.

expert_synthesis: Phaistos Disc Sign 29 (Cat's Head) depicts Feline head in full face (Cretan wildcat / Felis lybica). Iconographically, it correlates with Cretan Hieroglyphic CH_016 and Linear A AB23. Proposed phonetic assignments ['/za/'] remain tentative under the Shannon unicity limit.
skeptic_ruling: SKEPTIC RULING (Sign 29): Physical stamping die observed. Realia classification (Cat's Head) is well-supported by Middle Minoan iconography. Phonetic projection ['/za/'] carries high degrees of freedom and must be treated as a working hypothesis.
